correctness.rationale: All extreme generating vectors use the r largest labels  k,k-1,...,k-r+1; rearrangement gives h(G)=sum_{j<=min(k,m)}(k-j+1)(G_[j])_+ and active rank min(k,#positive Gaussian coordinates), hence exact binomial probability. Symmetric exchangeability gives each r<k vertex normal-cone solid angle 1/(2^m r!) and the saturated r=k tail. The normal cone orthogonally decomposes as type-B Weyl chamber and an orthant; known conic intrinsic-volume polynomial applies. Gaussian empirical descending quantiles converge with uniform integrability to the explicit H(alpha), with Gaussian Poincare concentration and radius normalization for directional and mean widths. The derivative H(alpha)=Phi^-1(1-alpha) left of 1/2 and H=0 right of it yields continuous first two derivatives and unequal third derivatives. Independent exhaustive small-m support computation checked 165 cases and five Gaussian quantile quadratures; the all-parameter statement follows from analytic arguments.
